title: WDD Replay Engine
description: Implement the `wdd replay` command in `lib/wdd/cli.py` and `lib/wdd/replay.py`. This reads the hash-chained ledger and sequentially prints out the execution history.

requirements.verification: Must recalculate the hash chain on the fly. If `current_hash` of entry N-1 does not match `previous_hash` of entry N, abort with a fatal cryptographic error.

acceptance_criteria: `wdd replay` prints the execution log and returns exit code 0 if hashes match.
failure_modes: FAIL: Skipping hash verification during replay.
